entities.summary: Luis Morales Reyes was a Roman Catholic archbishop-emeritus of the Archdiocese of San Luis Potosí in Mexico. He was succeeded by Jesús Carlos Cabrero Romero as archbishop of San Luis Potosí on 3 April 2012.
